edges.notes: illumos libc implements C and POSIX interfaces for hosted C on illumos distribution triplets.
illumos libc and the dynamic linker participate in ELF dynamic linking on supported architectures; Solaris/illumos ABI conventions apply.
GCC is commonly used in illumos distributions to build and link against libc.
GNU ld links against libc in typical illumos ELF flows.
Clang/LLVM may be used in illumos distributions and link against libc where configured.
